strategy.title: Every day
strategy.detail: Weeks 1–8: learn a topic, then practise it straight away. From the third day, spend the last 15 minutes on what you studied two days earlier — weak material comes back after two days in Sadhya's planner.

strategy.title: Every week
strategy.detail: End each learning week with a 20-question check quiz on its topics (“Quiz me on …”). A topic under 60% goes back into the next week; ask me “Analyze my quiz mistakes” to see which.

strategy.title: Timed practice
strategy.detail: Weeks 9–11: 25 questions in 15 minutes per subject, as in Tier-I. Speed comes after accuracy: review every mistake the same day.

strategy.title: Full-length tests
strategy.detail: Weeks 12–13: two full tests a week (Tier-I pattern: 100 questions in 60 minutes). After each, ask me “Analyze my last test” and fix the weakest topics before the next one.

strategy.title: Past papers
strategy.detail: Sadhya has no SSC CGL past papers I can offer as real papers yet, so timed practice uses practice questions, not real papers.

strategy.title: Data Entry Speed Test
strategy.detail: A skill test, practised rather than studied. The notice: “The “Data Entry Speed Test” (DEST) Skill Test will be conducted for a passage of about 2000 (two thousand) key depressions for a duration of 15 (fifteen) minutes.”

strategy.title: Falling behind
strategy.detail: Ask me to plan again: the plan is rebuilt from where you are, not from where it expected you to be.
